シミュレーション室で操縦せずに何かを観察しているルナ。\nそんな彼女が気になり声:
In the simulator room, Luna is watching something instead of piloting.
Curious, I go over to talk to her.
何をしてるんだ？\nそんなところでメモを取って。:
What are you doing?
Taking notes over here.
あ、%usernameusernameuserna%さん。\nその……他の人のシ:
Oh, %usernameusernameuserna%-san.
Um... I was studying other people's simulations.
はい……やっぱり、ＭＧの動き方の癖とか、他の人の操縦の立ち位置とか……そういった: Yes... The way their MGs move, the positions other pilots take... I'm watching things like that to learn...
サポートをする立ち位置って、意識しても分からないものが多くて……\nだから、優秀:
There's so much I don't understand about positioning for support, even when I try...

なるほどな……確かに他人の戦闘を客観的に見て、\n分析したりするのは良いことだと:
I see... Watching other people fight from the outside

俺の動きを参考にしてみるか？: Want to learn from my movements?

Then want to learn from my movements?
I pilot without weapons, so you should find things you can use to avoid combat.
えっ？ その……いいんですか？: Huh? Um... Would that be okay?
……あ、ありがとうございます。\n%usernameusernameuserna:
...Th-thank you.
For doing so much for me, %usernameusernameuserna%-san...
一挙手一投足見逃さず、すべて参考にさせていただきます！: I won't miss a single movement! I'll learn everything I can!
